series.title: Button animation
series.sub: Water, a fish, a frog and more, beside the volume key you press

steps.title: Open Button animation
steps.text: In Gesture Volume, under Advanced features, tap Button animation.

steps.title: Turn it on
steps.text: Switch on Animate the volume buttons. The preview at the top plays it, with nothing to press.

steps.title: Press a volume key
steps.text: Go home and press volume up: water ripples out from the very key you pressed.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.text: Back in Button animation, scroll down to Animation and tap one. Every animation is free.

steps.title: Each with a sound of its own
steps.text: Frog jump, Swing women, Cat, Balloons: tap one, and the preview plays it with its sound.

steps.title: Hold for a big one
steps.text: On the glass, a press lets a balloon float away. Hold the key, and it fills until it bursts.

steps.title: Line it up with your keys
steps.text: Under Where your buttons are, pick a key and slide Position. As you slide, the press shows on the glass, right beside it.

steps.title: Sound and feel
steps.text: Each animation plays its own sound at every press. Then pick how it buzzes, how long it stays and how fast it moves.

steps.title: With the Quick slider, or alone
steps.text: Pause plays the animation alone. Show both brings up the Quick slider with it.
